versions.changelog:
- Adds support for sending remote video URLs directly via --url (skill will download and send).
- Now requires explicit --receive-id for target chat, accepts context values like chat:oc_xxx.
- Updated documentation for when to use and clarified --file / --url usage (mutually exclusive).
- Improved explanation of receive-id formats and automatic prefix handling.
- Temporary files for remote video are cleaned up automatically after sending.

- Removed auxiliary metadata and documentation files: _meta.json and skill-card.md.
- No functional or user-facing changes to the main skill logic.

- Initial release: send videos as playable media messages via Feishu OpenAPI.
- Automatically generates a cover image from the first video frame (with option to skip).
- Detects video duration using ffprobe, included in the chat message.
- Supports common video formats (up to 30MB, MP4 for upload).
- Robust flow: if cover extraction or duration detection fails, video is still sent.
- CLI tool with flexible targeting and parameters.
